history.summary: backup-server's POST /upload takes an optional valid_for (positive Go duration, e.g. 52h). Once the backup lands it writes <object>.metadata.json holding {"valid_for":"52h"} as plain JSON. Invalid values are refused with 400 before anything is stored, and a failed metadata write cleans up and returns 500. Prune counts backups only and clears the metadata of pruned or missing backups. DockerImages 8ea9e12 on phase/023-P1: go vet and gofmt clean, go test ./... green. The done-record is appended, and P2/P4/P6 now name the parameter and the metadata seams.

The P1 code meets the phase outcome: valid_for is validated before storing, metadata is written after the backup lands as plain JSON, and prune counts backups only and clears orphans. vet, gofmt and the touched packages' tests pass under -race. No test holds V06's 'written only after the backup has landed' clause: a metadata-first mutation passes the suite.
